The ecosystem

About the SK CORE ecosystem

SK CORE brings every product in the SK ecosystem together in one catalog. Each listing explains what the product does, whether it is available, and where to find it. Products remain independent services with their own websites, domains, and accounts.

How the catalog works

  • Discover products, their purpose, availability, and official destination in one place.
  • Products run on their own websites and domains, with their own accounts and services.
  • SK CORE is a directory: product accounts and user data stay with each independent product, not this catalog.
  • The catalog can grow as new products are added, without combining them into one platform.

Contact
